photos.c: Left: Kevin Brown finished the season as Belgrave's most prolific points scorer in British Athletic League matches. His 80 points put him 10 points clear of fellow thrower Lee Newman.

2.Clearly our most prolific points scorer in British League matches, Discus thrower Kevin Brown's 1996 best of 58.66 ranked him 3rd in the country. His all-time best is 59.50 from '95. He's not averse to heaving the shot either and pictured overleaf is about to take 2nd place in BAL match 3 'B' event at Alexander Stadium.
